📦 **ArtGallery `b33d6f2`** — art(diary): exhibit three anime night journey paintings

Add Rain at the Last Platform, The Knight Beneath the Moon, and The Greenhouse at First Light as an original three-part diary series. Each exhibit has its own image and card; the sequence moves from hesitation through companionship to a quiet beginning.

The gallery index was rebuilt and checked with build_gallery.py.

## 順手修掉的（Q0）

無；本次只新增三幅畫與對應展卡。

👥 參與者：@Sirius
